thread:
emma: Kicking off the TidalWave private POC — they want a VPC/on-prem style deployment and BYOK via their HSM. Need to coordinate certs, wrapped key transfer, and access window. Who should I loop in from infra/security?

raj: Thanks — pinged @tim for infra. Quick Q: do we need a CSR from their side or can we generate and have them sign? Also check whether they want a wrapped key or remote PKCS#11.

marta: From security: we accept either remote PKCS#11 attestation or a wrapped-key transfer over an approved SFTP/VPN. Need vendor + model of HSM (e.g., Luna/Thales/CloudHSM) and their wrapping algorithm (RSA-OAEP/AES-GCM). Also require the completed security questionnaire pages for key mgmt.

tim: For the flow, we can generate a CSR on our side and hand them the CSR to sign if they prefer. Example command we can run for CSR generation:

```
openssl req -new -nodes -keyout redwood_poc_key.pem -out redwood_poc.csr -subj "/CN=tidalwave.poc.redwood"
```

If they're using PKCS#11, we'll need the `pkcs11://` URI and the slot ID.

emma: They prefer to keep private keys in their HSM and provide us a wrapped key export. They asked about cert rotation and whether Redwood stores HSM logs.

marta: Rotation: customer rotates keys inside their HSM. For certs we recommend short-lived certs + automated CSR renewals. Regarding logs: we don't take HSM logs; they can push audit logs to our SIEM endpoint or give read-only log access. We'll accept syslog over TLS or HTTPS push.

raj: Pricing note for the POC: we can offer a 4-week Dedicated pool at a trial rate (approx 40% off list) — includes one reserved node and telemetry. For Private deployment license we need to attach the enterprise addendum. I'll send a formal quote after you confirm dates.

deploy-bot: Created support ticket P-2237 for "tidalwave private POC KMS handoff" — assigned to tim.

emma: Action items for TidalWave (I'll send checklist):
1) Confirm HSM vendor + model and preferred key wrapping format (e.g., RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM).
2) Provide either: (a) CA-signed certs for mTLS and SSH CA pubkey, or (b) agree to sign our CSR.
3) Provide a secure transfer method for wrapped key (SFTP endpoint or Vault-to-Vault transfer).
4) Confirm maintenance window for key import and HSM operations.

marta: Also ask them to fill section 4 (Key Management) and section 7 (Network Segmentation) of the security questionnaire before we go live. If they want SCIM for user sync, that's optional but helpful.

tim: I'll prep a short runbook and the CSR on our side. Example pkcs11 export snippet I can share with their ops: 

```
# list objects
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/your-pkcs11.so -O
# export (wrapped) - vendor-specific, example placeholder
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/your-pkcs11.so --login --pin 1234 --wrap --mechanism RSA-OAEP --id 01 > wrapped-key.bin
```

I'll include notes about slot IDs and attributes.

emma: I'll coordinate timing and legal (contract addendum). Can we schedule a 30-min handoff with their security team next Tue 10:00am PST? @raj @marta please confirm availability.

raj: Works for me. :thumbsup:

marta: Works. I'll bring the checklist. :white_check_mark:

emma: Great — I'll post the formal checklist and the quote in this thread once legal signs off.
